newsitem.title: USA: US adj chain store sales up 0.2 pct - BTM/Schroders. [CORRECTED 13:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: US adj chain store sales up 0.2 pct - BTM/Schroders. [CORRECTED 13:40 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects figure in headline from "off 1.7 pct", to conform with text.)
U.S. chain store sales increased 0.2 percent in the week ended September 14 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
Sales for the week were up 4.7 percent on a year-over-year basis, while the month-to-date index dropped 0.6 percent from the prior month.
"Sales were soft early in the week but a number of retailers noted that as weather improved late in the week, sales picked up as well," a BTM/Schroders report said.
